title: Planned maintenance: server move
note: Planned work: clippy.gg moved to its own server. Recording and saving clips in the app kept working the whole time. Sharing and sign-in were unavailable for about eight minutes.

title: Server outage
note: The server behind clippy.gg froze and had to be restarted. Recording in the app kept working the whole time. Sharing, sign-in and update checks were unavailable for about 15 minutes.
